486-1008-1978.easyPrerequisites: Undermountain Adventurer doesn't have summoning sickness.
486-1008-1978.description:
Cause Undermountain Adventurer to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Undermountain Adventurer by tapping it, adding six {G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Undermountain Adventurer.
Repeat

628-3899-5405.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Soulstinger.
When Soulstinger dies, its undying ability and second ability trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, optionally putting -1/-1 counter(s) on another creature.
Resolve the Soulstinger trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Soulstinger enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

2358-4591-8089.description:
Activate Blood Celebrant by paying {B} and 1 life, adding {B}
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

225-2557-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1308-3129-4772-4826-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2626-3652-3967-4986.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1594-4399-4518-6719.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Dazzling Angel trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dazzling Angel trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-4399-4518-6719.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

511-817-851-4050-7704.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

2034-5003-6773-7297.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

215-4010-4460-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-4010-4460-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

1409-5420-5921.description:
Activate Plundering Pirate by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Plundering Pirate enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Plundering Pirate.
Resolve both Plundering Pirate triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

483-2511-5170-6132.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1251-2366-3430-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1251-2366-3430-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

997-4352-6972--112.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Maulfist Squad.
When Maulfist Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Maulfist Squad enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
997-4352-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Maulfist Squad's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

315-3755-4465--138.description:
Activate the Sliver that can be cast using {B}{B} by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
The Sliver is put onto the top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to the replacement effect given to it by Pulmonic Sliver.
Cast the Sliver from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

681-1669-5478-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-1669-5478-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat from step 2.

4549-5051-5078-6766.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Traxos, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

3156-6014.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures, one of which must have Demonmail Hauberk attached to it.
3156-6014.description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing the creature it is attached to, targeting another creature you control.
When the creature dies, Guardian of the Forgotten triggers, causing you to manifest the top card of your library.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk trigger, attaching it to the targeted creature.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1387-1500-2871-6596.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}. Birgi, Blood Funnel and Hermes trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Hermes trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Seething Anger spell.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Dryad of the Ilysian Grove

907-4572-4826-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
907-4572-4826-5702.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters untapped due to Archelos, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove.
Because of the additional Dryad of the Ilysian Grove token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

539-4657-4747.notablePrerequisites: You had a creature with power 3 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.
539-4657-4747.description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Alena.
Repeat.

64-2061-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Warp each turn.
64-2061-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye.
When the Warden of the Eye token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-3143-3545.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token with base power and toughness 1/1.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a removable counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-3545.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a copy of a 1/1 creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Sigil Captain trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Sigil Captain trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on the creature token.
Repeat.

527-5140-5231.manaNeeded: {G}, plus {R} if Selvala has summoning sickness
527-5140-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater that isn't Selvala.
527-5140-5231.description:
If Selvala has summoning sickness, activate Kenrith's first ability by paying {R}, giving all creatures haste until end of turn.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {4}{B}{G}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Selvala, adding {R}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
527-5140-5231.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

586-2906-3967-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 1 life this turn.
586-2906-3967-5258-5618.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3705-4050-4365-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating two 2/2 Alien Warrior creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warriors, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1365-1379-4853-5147--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1379-4853-5147--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

293-997-5220-5716.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Narcomoeba.
When Narcomoeba dies, Selhoff Occultist and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Narcomoeba from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Selhoff Occultist trigger, causing you to mill Narcomoeba from the top of your library.
Narcomoeba triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2645-3918-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
2645-3918-4002.description:
Activate Trazyn using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2645-3918-4002.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities via Trazyn.

360-1770-1981-4591-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 50.
360-1770-1981-4591-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, creating fifty 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers 100 times, causing you to gain 100 life.
Repeat.

396-851-2034-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking any other nontoken creature you control.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating two 2/2 Unicorn creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Unicorns, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1379-1636-4170.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional permanent.
1379-1636-4170.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token that is an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
When the Inkling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

942-2438-2523.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Samwise.
When Samwise dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Samwise that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Samwise token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning up to one applicable card from your graveyard to your hand, and then causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Samwise token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

230-3002-4871.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a card in exile.
230-3002-4871.description:
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card an opponent owns from exile into their graveyard.
The card is instead put back into exile due to Rest in Peace.
Resolve the Void Attendant ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
The Eldrazi Scion dies, triggering Pitliess Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

628-2290-5256.notablePrerequisites: Spike Feeder has no +1/+1 counters on it.
628-2290-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Spike Feeder.
Spike Feeder's undying ability triggers, returning itself to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Spike Feeder's power.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to gain six life.
Repeat.

719-4242-4640-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Oathkeeper attached to Su-Chi.
Samurai chosen with Xenograft.
719-4242-4640-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Su-Chi.
Su-Chi and Oathkeeper triggers.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Oathkeeper trigger, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
Equip Oathkeeper to Su-Chi by paying {2}.

2521-2836.notablePrerequisites: No creatures in library.You control fewer creatures than target player.
2521-2836.description:
During the upkeep, Oath of Druids will trigger.
Target the player with more creatures than you and mill your entire library, draw a card for turn and win.

524-3149.description:
Aether Storm prevents any player from casting creature spells.
Avacyn causes Aether Storm to become indestructible, and thus it cannot be destroyed by its ability.

568-2103-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional Islands.
568-2103-4423.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary to put Capture of Jingzhou on top of your library.
Cast Capsize for its buyback cost by paying {4}{U}{U}, returning Mystic Sanctuary to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

790-1368-4682.notablePrerequisites:
A player has at least three cards in hand.
There are at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
At least one opponent is unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
790-1368-4682.description:
Cast Windfall from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard, causing each player to discard at least three cards and draw at least three cards.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each card drawn by your opponents, creating that many Treasure tokens.
Activate three of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}.
Repeat.
